column3: The recipe uses from one to three ingredients
A recipe can use different replsements for each of the ingredients
Only components with lower or equal Tier are used in the recipe

If an ingredient has different variants of components, the ingredient with the lowest rarity is used in the recipe by default. For components with higher rarity recipe uses a 50% less amount with each rarity level.
One product line for one product in the building
These sheets contain a list of resources and recipes.
column4: Resource - name of th resource Short Name - Short name of the resource (for tips) Rarity - the rarity of the resource. Required to adjust the biome generator, and also for some recipe rules Tier - Required to check the recipe and production balance Type - Additional parameter, parsing not needed Tag - Additional parameter, parsing not needed Description - description of the resource Ingredients are the components of a resource (if it is produced). The recipe can be empty, for example, for water, ore or other specific resources. Each ingredient can have up to 5 alternatives. If an ingredient has an alternative, it is written with a ”, ” separator. Ingredient 1 - Name of the ingridient 1 I1 count - count of Ingridient 1 Ingredient 2 - Name of the ingridient 2 I2 count - count of Ingridient 2 Ingredient 3 - Name of the ingridient 3 I3 count - count of Ingridient 3 Result Amount - the amount of resource you get
